To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
using a light stemming tool with a good performing Feature Selection method can improve the performance of the system.
using the light stemmer combined to the best performing feature selection method (Chi2) enhanced the performance of Arabic TC especially for small threshold.
the light stemming tool has the highest performance among all the morphological tools.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1.
the effect of the text preprocessing tools on Arabic Text Categorisation.
studying the effect of using morphological processing tools in Arabic text categorization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
using morphological tools during preprocessing stage in Arabic TC has a positive effect.
using a morphological tool for Arabic TC is a good idea.
the effect of using morphological tool depends on several factors including the language of the corpus, the size of the corpus, and the feature selection method used.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
using a good performing feature reduction technique in combination with a light stemming tool is the most efficient way of using the morphological tools in Arabic TC.
Arabic Text Categorizer should not use the root text.
using morphological tools for preprocessing Arabic text for text categorization is beneficial.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the preprocessing tool should be selected carefully according to the application.
morphological analysis can help in reducing the number of features and the memory required to store the training and test documents.
using a light morphological tool is a good trade-off between performance, storage requirements, and computational resources.
